component.name: Orion
component.summary: Audio mixer and routing workspace for Linux

description.p: Orion is a free software audio mixer and routing workspace for Linux, built in Rust with GPUI. It provides a mixer console for physical, application, desktop, and virtual audio sources, physical and virtual output buses, a routing matrix, scenes, and engine settings.

Orion is under active development: the current milestone delivers the complete mixer interface and PipeWire device discovery, while the audio engine and virtual devices are being connected incrementally.
